note: Kansas State Parks area at the north end of Tuttle Creek Lake off K-16, about 25 miles north of Manhattan: two electric loops (168-179 in the woods, 180-191 on open ground above the lake's upper arm) and primitive camping around the Hidden Hollow loop. --Claude
